newsitem.title: USA: U.S. 3-, 6-mo bills rate seen at 5.11 and 5.15 pct.
newsitem.headline: U.S. 3-, 6-mo bills rate seen at 5.11 and 5.15 pct.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's sale of $17.0 billion in three- and six-month bills on Monday was expected to garner discount rates of 5.11 and 5.15 percent, respectively, market participants said.
In when-issued trade at about 1240 EDT/1640 GMT, the three-month bill rate was quoted at 5.11 percent while the six-month bill was at 5.145 percent.
Dealers said they expected decent demand with the six-month doing better than the three-month. The six-month looks cheaper to other issues such as the year-bill (5.22 percent), players noted.
The bidding deadline for the auction is 1300 EDT/1700 GMT. Results are expected around 1345 EDT/1745 GMT.
